title: Multifunctional pectin derivatives as anticancer agents in colorectal cancer via synthesis, computational insights, and modulation of NRF2/HO-1, HIF-1alpha, and VEGF/PDGF-D signaling pathways.
authors: Elsayed, Ghada H; Fahim, Asmaa M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究果胶衍生物的抗癌活性，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: This research describes the design, synthesis, characterization, and biological assessment of new Pectin-based Hydrazide and Oxadiazole derivatives as possible anticancer agents. The chemical modification of native Pectin was accomplished using a sequence of esterification, Hydrazide formation, and cyclization with carbon disulfide to yield Pectin Hydrazide (3) and Pectin Oxadiazole (5), confirmed using FT-IR, (1)H/(13)C NMR, elemental, SEM, and TGA analyses. The in vitro anticancer activity of the synthesized Pectin derivatives was evaluated against HepG2 and Caco2 cancer cells using the neutral red uptake test. Pectin Oxadiazole (IC(50) = 23.5 mug/mL) and Pectin Hydrazide (IC(50) = 39.5 mug/mL) demonstrated the most potent cytotoxic effects against Caco2 cells after 48 h. ELISA assays showed significant reductions in ROS activity and HO-1 protein levels, while qRT-PCR confirmed significant suppression of NRF2, HIF-1alpha, VEGF, and PDGF-D gene expression in Caco2 cells treated with these Pectin derivatives. Molecular docking and 100-ns molecular dynamics simulations against several cancer-related targets (PDB IDs: 1lc8, 1n3u, 1u6d, 3nl0, 5k5x) demonstrated that Pectin Oxadiazole had a stronger binding affinity with greater structure stability and greater DeltaG(_bind) (- 34 to - 82 kcal/mol) along with a much lower RMSD profile. Additionally, density functional theory (DFT/B3LYP/6-31G) calculations suggested that the presence of N- and S-containing heterocycles resulted in lower HOMO-LUMO gaps and improved dipole moments, thereby increasing electronic reactivity and charge transfer characteristics. Taken together, the Pectin Oxadiazole and Pectin Hydrazide derivatives show combined cytotoxic, antioxidant, and anti-angiogenic activities, thus warranting further investigation toward novel multifunctional agents for the treatment of colorectal cancer.
abstract_zh: 本研究描述了新型果胶基酰肼和噁二唑衍生物作为潜在抗癌药物的设计、合成、表征及生物学评估。通过酯化、酰肼形成及与二硫化碳环化的一系列化学修饰，将天然果胶转化为果胶酰肼（3）和果胶噁二唑（5），并通过FT-IR、¹H/¹³C NMR、元素分析、SEM和TGA分析予以确认。利用中性红摄取试验评估了合成的果胶衍生物对HepG2和Caco2癌细胞的体外抗癌活性。果胶噁二唑（IC₅₀ = 23.5 μg/mL）和果胶酰肼（IC₅₀ = 39.5 μg/mL）在48小时后对Caco2细胞表现出最强的细胞毒性效应。ELISA检测显示，经这些果胶衍生物处理的Caco2细胞中ROS活性和HO-1蛋白水平显著降低，而qRT-PCR证实NRF2、HIF-1α、VEGF和PDGF-D基因表达受到显著抑制。针对多个癌症相关靶点（PDB ID：1lc8、1n3u、1u6d、3nl0、5k5x）的分子对接和100 ns分子动力学模拟表明，果胶噁二唑具有更强的结合亲和力、更高的结构稳定性及更大的ΔG_bind（-34至-82 kcal/mol），同时RMSD曲线更低。此外，密度泛函理论（DFT/B3LYP/6-31G）计算表明，含N和S杂环的存在导致更低的HOMO-LUMO能隙和更高的偶极矩，从而增强了电子反应性和电荷转移特性。综上所述，果胶噁二唑和果胶酰肼衍生物展现出细胞毒性、抗氧化和抗血管生成活性，值得进一步研究，以开发用于结直肠癌治疗的新型多功能药物。
